title: Too Good to be Bad: On the Failure of LLMs to Role-Play Villains
reasoning: The paper introduces the Moral RolePlay benchmark to evaluate LLMs on their ability to portray characters across a four-level moral alignment scale (Moral Paragons, Flawed-but-Good, Egoists, and Villains). It specifically studies the tension between safety alignment and the simulation of immoral or unethical personas.
